# Vortex Mangás

Vortex Mangás is a web application built with React and Vite. It is a catalog for mangas, manhuas, and manhwas.
It uses the public MangaDex API to fetch data.

## Features
- Search mangas by title
- Filter by genres, demographics, status, and format
- Explicit content toggle
- Sort by relevance, rating, or latest
- Read manga synopses and metadata

## Technologies
- React
- React Router
- Capacitor (for Android)
